blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We evaluated synthetic pretraining and multi-cohort transfer learning for deep learning-based super-resolution of intracranial 4D Flow MRI across heterogeneous neurologic cohorts. This mixed prospective-retrospective study analyzed 18 participants (12 healthy participants, 3 with moyamoya disease, and 3 with multiple sclerosis) with paired 1.2-mm and 0.6-mm 4D Flow MRI scans. A convolutional neural network pretrained on synthetic cerebrovascular data was fine-tuned using cohort-specific or pooled multi-cohort in vivo data. High-resolution-derived inputs enabled voxel-wise evaluation; native standard-resolution scans were used for angiographic and hemodynamic analyses. Synthetic pretraining reduced mean artery-wise velocity-normalized root mean square error (vNRMSE) versus interpolation (0.147 vs 0.166). Pooled transfer learning yielded the lowest mean vNRMSE (0.119 vs 0.127 for cohort-specific models and 0.147 for synthetic pretraining), with narrower 95% limits-of-agreement widths than synthetic pretraining across all test cases (0.109-0.222 vs 0.154-0.278 m/s). Super-resolved phase-contrast angiography achieved higher precision-recall area under the curve than native standard-resolution imaging in all cohorts (0.848-0.896 vs 0.486-0.805). These results indicate that pooled transfer learning improves cross-cohort reconstruction agreement and that super-resolution can improve vessel depiction, supporting further multi-center validation for cerebrovascular imaging.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Traditionally, neurovascular disease has been diagnosed from an anatomical paradigm, with imaging techniques primarily used to qualitatively visualize intracranial vascular morphology and pathology. Yet many clinical questions are fundamentally hemodynamic, including whether flow is compromised distal to a stenosis, whether collateral supply is sufficient, or how flow redistributes after revascularization. Quantitative clinical intracranial hemodynamic assessment, however, remains challenging, with the shielding cranium, limited interrogation windows, and tortuous vascular anatomy restricting the use of routine tools used in other vascular compartments Naqvi et al. (2013) ; Morgan et al. (2021) . In this context, four-dimensional flow magnetic resonance imaging (4D Flow MRI) enables non-invasive visualization and quantification of cerebrovascular blood flow across a large vascular territory Schnell et al. (2016) ; Wåhlin et al. (2022) . However, despite translational advances in acquisition, correction, and quantification Schnell et al. (2017) ; Ma et al. (2020) ; Aristova et al. (2022) ; Rivera-Rivera et al. (2022) ; Wen et al. (2019) , a fundamental trade-off remains between spatial resolution, signal-to-noise ratio, and scan time: high-resolution acquisitions are lengthy and impractical, whereas standard-resolution acquisitions cannot capture small branches, underestimate peak velocities, and reduce vessel conspicuity. These challenges are particularly relevant in steno-occlusive disease such as moyamoya, where hemodynamic assessment depends on resolving altered flow in small collateral vessels and the downstream circulation Matsushige et al. (2018) ; Yu et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 传统上,神经血管病是从解剖学范式中诊断出来的,其成像技术主要用于对颅内血管形态和病理学进行质的可视化. 然而,许多临床问题从根本上来说是血动力学,包括流量是否被分解为快感,抵押供应是否足够,或流量在再血管化后如何再生等. 然而,临床内颅出血力学定量评估仍然具有挑战性,屏蔽性颅骨、有限的审讯窗口和曲折血管解剖限制了其他血管隔间使用的常规工具的使用(2013年);Morgan等(2021年)。 在这方面,四维流动磁共振成像(4D Flow MRI)能够对跨越一个大血管领土的脑血管血流进行非侵入可视化和定量(2016年);Wåhlin等(2022年)。 然而,尽管在获取、校正和量化Schnell等人(2017年),Ma等人(2020年),Aristova等人(2022年),Rivera-Rivera等人(2022年),Wen等人(2019年),在空间分辨率、信号-噪音比和扫描时间之间仍然存在着根本的取舍:高分辨率的获取是漫长而不切实际的,而标准分辨率的获取不能捕捉小分支,低估了高峰速度,降低了船只的吸引力。 这些挑战在诸如moyamoya等含臭性疾病中尤为相关,在这种疾病中,出血力学评估取决于如何解决小附担保船舶和下游环流的改变性流动(2018年);Yu等(2023年)。

blocks.en: To address this, deep learning-based super-resolution has emerged as a practical strategy to increase image resolution without extending scan time or modifying hardware or pulse sequences, with the potential to sharpen vessel depiction and improve hemodynamic quantification post-scan Ferdian et al. (2023) ; Shit et al. (2022) . However, existing intracranial super-resolution models are predominantly trained on synthetic surrogate data, with in vivo validation generally limited to small cohorts or indirect reference settings Ferdian et al. (2023) ; Shit et al. (2022) ; Ericsson et al. (2024) . Specifically, it remains unclear whether synthetic training generalizes sufficiently to in vivo scans - where noise characteristics, anatomy, and disease-related flow patterns differ - or whether additional adaptation is required. In this context, transfer learning offers a potential mechanism for adapting synthetic-pretrained models to in vivo data, supported by extensive evidence from other imaging domains Valverde et al. (2021) . However, the benefit of such fine-tuning for intracranial super-resolution 4D Flow MRI, particularly across heterogeneous clinical cohorts, has not been established.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题,深层以学习为基础的超分辨率已经成为一种实用战略,在不延长扫描时间或修改硬件或脉冲序列的情况下,增加图像分辨率,并有可能使容器描述更加清晰并改进扫描后Ferdian等人(2023年); Shit等人(2022年)。 然而,现有的颅内超分辨率模型主要接受合成代位数据培训,活体验证一般仅限于小群或间接参考环境Ferdian等 (2023年); Shit等 (2022年); Ericsson等 (2024年). 具体地说,目前还不清楚的是,合成培训是否在活体扫描(噪音特征、解剖学和与疾病有关的流动模式各不相同)中充分概括,还是需要进一步调整。 在这方面,转移学习提供了一种潜在机制,在从其他成像领域Valverde等人(2021年)获得的大量证据的支持下,使人工合成预选模型适应活性数据。 然而,这种微调对颅内超分辨4D流磁共振的惠益,特别是针对不同临床组群的这些惠益尚未确定。

blocks.en: The aim of this study was therefore to evaluate the in vivo performance and cross-cohort generalization of a synthetic-pretrained super-resolution model for intracranial 4D Flow MRI using paired standard- and high-resolution acquisitions, and to determine whether transfer learning provides additional benefit across clinically relevant neurological cohorts. We hypothesized that transfer learning would improve performance on acquired in vivo data, reflected by reduced reconstruction error relative to synthetic pretraining alone. We further evaluated angiographic vessel depiction and quantitative hemodynamic performance to assess the clinical potential of super-resolution across diverse cerebrovascular settings.
blocks.zh: 因此,这项研究的目的是利用对等的标准和高分辨率的获取,评价人工四维流体内核磁共振合成预受精超分辨率模型的活性能和交叉共通性,并确定转移学习是否为临床相关神经群提供了额外好处。 我们假设,转学学习将改善从活体数据中获得的性能,这反映在重建错误相对于合成预训而言有所减少。 我们进一步评价了血管学容器的描述和定量出血动力性能,以评估超分辨率在不同脑血管环境中的临床潜力。

blocks.en: 2.1 Study Design and Participants
blocks.zh: 2.1 学习设计和参与者

blocks.en: This mixed prospective-retrospective study evaluated the in vivo generalization of a synthetic-pretrained super-resolution model and whether transfer learning improved performance across heterogeneous cohorts. The study included 18 participants (8 women, 10 men; mean age, 35.4 years; range, 23–70 years) in four cohorts: healthy intracranial ( n = 6 n=6 ), healthy extracranial ( n = 6 n=6 ), neurovascular (moyamoya, n = 3 n=3 ), and neuroinflammatory (multiple sclerosis, n = 3 n=3 ). An overview of the study and evaluation workflow is provided in Figure 1 . The intracranial cohorts were prospectively enrolled between March 16, 2025 and November 19, 2025. The extracranial cohort was retrospectively selected from examinations acquired between August 26, 2024 and September 24, 2024. Healthy participants were recruited as volunteers. Eligibility for the patient cohorts required a clinical diagnosis of moyamoya disease or multiple sclerosis, respectively, and no contraindications for MRI. Participants were enrolled based on availability during the study period, and all datasets meeting the study criteria were included. No formal power calculation was performed; the sample size was based on the available paired acquisitions and the feasibility of participant-level training and held-out test partitions.

blocks.en: 2.2 MRI Acquisition and Image Processing
blocks.zh: 2.2 磁共振成像仪的获取和图像处理

blocks.en: All participants underwent dual-velocity-encoding, kt-GRAPPA-accelerated 4D Flow MRI at 3 T (acceleration factor R = 5 R=5 ), with paired standard-resolution (LR; 1.2-mm isotropic) and high-resolution (HR; 0.6-mm isotropic) acquisitions and 3D time-of-flight (TOF) MR angiography. For the intracranial cohorts, the imaging field of view was centered on the Circle of Willis, whereas the extracranial cohort was acquired with the field of view centered on the cervical carotid arteries. Intracranial and extracranial imaging were performed on two scanner platforms at separate sites. Acquisition parameters are summarized in Table 2 .

blocks.en: 4D Flow MRI was processed using a standardized semiautomatic workflow in MATLAB (MathWorks), as described previously Vali et al. (2019) ; Aristova et al. (2019) ; Winter et al. (2024) . A single TOF-derived vessel segmentation was generated per participant and rigidly registered (SPM12 Wellcome Centre for Human Neuroimaging, UCL (2014) ) separately to the native LR and HR acquisitions. Data preprocessing, vessel labeling, centerline extraction, analysis-plane placement, and direction-consistency mask refinement are detailed in the Supplemental Material, Section S1.

blocks.en: 2.3 Super-Resolution Model and Transfer Learning
blocks.zh: 2.3 超分辨率模型和转移学习

blocks.en: Synthetic pretraining used four patient-specific cerebrovascular computational fluid dynamics (CFD) velocity fields converted to paired synthetic low- and high-resolution 4D Flow MRI using an acquisition-mimicking pipeline incorporating k-space truncation, noise injection, and dual-velocity-encoding reconstruction. A residual 3D convolutional neural network (CNN) received three velocity components and magnitude information and predicted super-resolved velocity fields. Both synthetic pretraining and in vivo fine-tuning used a region-weighted mean-square-error training objective that included a non-fluid objective to suppress extravascular predictions. Synthetic data generation, network architecture, and training details are provided in Supplemental S2.

blocks.en: Five transfer-learned model variants were trained: four cohort-specific models and one pooled multi-cohort model. HR-derived LR inputs generated by k-space cropping were used for supervised fine-tuning and voxel-wise testing to ensure exact spatial and temporal correspondence. Native standard-resolution acquisitions were used for angiographic and hemodynamic analyses. For each cohort, one participant was held out for final testing. In the two healthy cohorts ( n = 6 n=6 each), four participants were used for training and one additional participant was used for participant-independent validation. In the two patient cohorts ( n = 3 n=3 each), one participant was held out for testing and the remaining two were used for training. Since no separate validation participant was available, validation was performed at the patch level by re-sampling patches from one of the training participants. Validation data were used only to monitor fine-tuning performance and select model weights, whereas all final evaluations were performed on the held-out test participants. The pooled multi-cohort model used the combined training and validation data from all cohorts and was evaluated on the same held-out test participants as the cohort-specific models. Detailed partitions, patch sampling, and model-selection procedures are provided in Supplemental S3. Code for model training and evaluation, together with trained model weights, will be made publicly available upon publication.

blocks.en: 2.4 Outcome Measures and Evaluation

blocks.en: The primary model-performance outcome was artery-wise voxel-wise reconstruction error between super-resolved velocities and the matched HR reference, quantified using velocity-normalized root mean square error (vNRMSE). Secondary outcomes included Bland–Altman agreement at peak systole, phase-contrast MR angiography (PCMRA) vessel depiction relative to the co-registered TOF-derived anatomical reference using precision–recall area under the curve (PR-AUC) and maximum Dice coefficient ( D ​ i ​ c ​ e max Dice_{\max} ), and comparisons against native-acquisition hemodynamic measures, including flow rate ( Q Q ), 95th-percentile velocity ( v p ​ 95 v_{p95} ), voxel-wise velocity distributions, and mean absolute divergence. The publicly available cerebrovascular 4DFlowNet model was applied to the same held-out data as an external model benchmark.

blocks.en: In Figure 2 , voxel-wise prediction performance is summarized across labeled arteries and averaged over the cardiac cycle for each cohort and model. Across cohorts, the CFD-pretrained model consistently improved on interpolation (mean aggregate vNRMSE: 0.147 vs 0.166), indicating that the synthetic-pretrained baseline retained transferable performance on acquired in vivo data. Transfer learning further reduced vNRMSE in most arteries, with the pooled multi-cohort model yielding the lowest mean vNRMSE (0.119 vs 0.127 for the matched cohort-specific models and 0.147 for CFD). Cohort-specific transfer learning generally showed strong within-cohort performance but less consistent cross-cohort transfer. For example, the extracranial-tuned model reduced mean vNRMSE relative to CFD in the extracranial test case (0.090 vs 0.112) but performed less favorably when transferred to intracranial test cohorts (0.168 vs 0.151). In contrast, the pooled model showed consistent performance across the four test cases (mean vNRMSE: 0.119). Performance also varied by anatomical location, with larger arteries generally exhibiting lower errors (e.g., ICA and BA; mean vNRMSE: 0.082) as compared to smaller distal branches (e.g., MCA, ACA and PCA; mean vNRMSE: 0.152).
blocks.zh: 在图2中,不同标注的动脉对阴道的预测性能进行了总结,并在每组和模型的心脏周期中进行平均。 跨组别,CFD预受训练的模型在插值(平均总和 vNRMSE:0.147 vs 6.166)上不断改进,表明合成预受训练的基线保留了在活体数据中获得的可转让性能. 转移学习在大多数动脉中进一步减少了vNRMSE,集合多管模型产生最低的平均值vNRMSE(对应组别特定模型0.119对0.127,CFD0.147). 科霍特特特异性转会学习一般表现出强烈的科霍特内向性能,但交叉转会的一致性较低. 例如,外核调试型号在外核试例(0.090对0.112)中比CFD降低平均vNRMSE,但在转至外核试组时表现较差(0.168对0.151)。 相比之下,集合模型在四个测试案例(平均 vNRMSE: 0.119.)中表现一致. 性能也因解剖位置而异,较大的动脉一般显示出较低的出错(如ICA和BA;平均vNRMSE:0.082)而小于分枝(如MCA,ACA和PCA;平均vNRMSE:0.152)。

blocks.en: In Figure 4 , PCMRA visualizations derived from LR, HR, and super-resolved reconstructions across all four cohorts are compared with the corresponding TOF angiography as anatomical reference. Consistent with the background-suppression objective incorporated during training, all three super-resolution models showed reduced background signal relative to LR and HR, with visually clearer delineation of major arterial branches. In the neuroinflammatory case, the M2 branches were faint on LR and HR PCMRA but more clearly visualized on the super-resolved images. In the neurovascular case, the carotid siphon and downstream branches were likewise more apparent after super-resolution. Smaller vessels surrounding the affected proximal M1 were also more apparent on super-resolved PCMRA than on LR and HR, although their depiction remained incomplete relative to TOF.
blocks.zh: 在图4中,从LR,HR,以及所有四个组群的超解重建中衍生出来的PCMRA可视化与对应的TOF血管造影学作为解剖学的参考. 与培训过程中纳入的背景压制目标相一致,所有三个超分辨率模型都显示相对于LR和HR的背景信号下降,主要动脉分支的划分明显更清晰。 在神经炎症病例中,M2分支在LR和HR PCMRA上被晕倒了,但在超解的图像上被更清晰地视觉. 在神经血管病例中,颈动脉吸管和下游分支在超解后也同样更明显. 在超溶解的PCMRA上,环绕受影响的近缘M1的舰只也比LR和HR上更明显,尽管相对于TOF来说,它们的描述仍然不完整.

blocks.en: The qualitative findings were supported by quantitative comparison with the TOF-derived vessel masks. PR-AUC was higher for every super-resolved model than for native LR or HR in all four test cases (LR: 0.486 0.486 – 0.805 0.805 ; HR: 0.206 0.206 – 0.457 0.457 ; CFD: 0.816 0.816 – 0.883 0.883 ; COHORT: 0.845 0.845 – 0.893 0.893 ; POOL: 0.848 0.848 – 0.896 0.896 ). Corresponding D ​ i ​ c ​ e max Dice_{\max} values were 0.585 0.585 – 0.756 0.756 for LR, 0.414 0.414 – 0.639 0.639 for HR, 0.727 0.727 – 0.830 0.830 for CFD, 0.780 0.780 – 0.813 0.813 for COHORT, and 0.779 0.779 – 0.813 0.813 for POOL.

blocks.en: Figure 5 summarizes plane-based hemodynamic comparisons across all four test cases. Visual inspection of the velocity-field panels showed that the super-resolved reconstructions had more spatially continuous velocity patterns than LR, particularly within higher-velocity flow regions. In the neurovascular case, TOF-derived segmentation incompletely captured several smaller vessels within the moyamoya-associated region. Four such vessels were therefore selected for exploratory analysis and labeled MMV-1–MMV-4, with super-resolved PCMRA-derived masks used to define these regions consistently across LR, HR, CFD, and POOL.
blocks.zh: 图5汇总了所有四个试验病例的平面血动力学比较。 对速度-场面面板的目视检查表明,超解重建比LR更具有空间连续速度模式,特别是在高速度流量区域内. 在神经血管病例中,从TOF衍生的分解不完整地捕获了moyamoya相关区域内的几只较小的血管。 因此,挑选了四艘这类船只进行探索性分析,并标有MMV-1-MMV-4的标签,并配有超级溶解的PCMRA出产口罩,用于在LR、HR、CFD和POOL之间一致界定这些地区。

blocks.en: Table 3 provides artery-level peak-systolic flow estimates across all analyzed vessel segments. For readability, the largest value for each velocity-distribution metric and the lowest divergence value per artery are shown in bold; boldface is descriptive and does not indicate statistical significance. blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: In this study, we performed a preliminary multi-cohort in vivo evaluation of super-resolution for intracranial 4D Flow MRI, focusing on synthetic-to- in vivo generalization and the effect of transfer learning across neurological cohorts and acquisition settings. The synthetic-pretrained model generalized across all four test cohorts, while transfer learning provided additional improvements in reconstruction error and voxel-wise agreement. Pooled multi-cohort fine-tuning showed the most consistent overall performance compared with cohort-specific adaptation. Super-resolution also improved angiographic vessel depiction and enabled exploratory hemodynamic assessment in vessel segments that were poorly depicted at native resolution. Together, these findings support super-resolution 4D Flow MRI as a proof-of-principle approach to higher-resolution cerebrovascular flow assessment.

blocks.en: The synthetic-to- in vivo performance of the CFD-pretrained model supports the use of acquisition-mimicking synthetic data for pretraining Welin Odeback et al. (2026) . Previous intracranial 4D Flow MRI super-resolution studies have largely relied on synthetic training data generated through simpler downsampling or k-space cropping procedures, with in vivo evaluation often limited to small cohorts or indirect reference settings Shit et al. (2022) ; Ferdian et al. (2023) ; Rutkowski et al. (2021) . In contrast, our pipeline produces a synthetic domain sufficiently representative of clinical image data to support evaluation without in vivo adaptation, consistently yielding higher voxel-wise agreement as compared to the reference 4DFlowNet network Ferdian et al. (2023) , and serving as a solid pretrained foundation for subsequent transfer learning.
blocks.zh: CFD预导模型的活性能的合成到活性能支持将获取-模仿合成数据用于预训Welin Odeback等 (2026). 以前的4D内流磁共振超分辨率研究主要依靠通过更简单的下采样或k-空间收割程序生成的合成培训数据,在活体评价中往往仅限于小组群或间接参考环境 Shit等 (2022); Ferdian等 (2023); Rutkowski等 (2021). 相比之下,我们的管道生产出一个足够能代表临床图像数据的合成域,以支持在没有活体适应的情况下进行评价,与参考文献4DFlowNet Network Ferdian et al. (2023年)相比,始终得出较高的阴道协议,并成为后续转移学习的坚实的先行基础。

blocks.en: Continuing, transfer learning incrementally improved reconstruction accuracy, revealing a practical observation: diversity in fine-tuning data may be preferred over narrowly targeted tuning. While cohort-specific models performed well within their own domain, they showed reduced cross-cohort performance under domain shift , most notably when transferring from extracranial carotid vessels into intracranial distal arteries. In contrast, pooled multi-cohort fine-tuning consistently exceeded cohort-specific performance, even when compared to domain-specific networks. While extension into even more distal vessels remains undetermined, these observations support further exploration of broadly adapted models trained on heterogeneous clinical cases, rather than relying exclusively on separate models for each clinical subgroup.
blocks.zh: 继续,转移学习逐步提高重建精度,揭示出一种实用的观察:微调数据的多样性可能比狭隘的定向调取更可取. 虽然特定组别模型在自己的领域内表现良好,但它们在域外移动下,尤其是当从外颈动脉转向内颈动脉时,跨轴性能下降。 相比之下,即使与特定域的网络相比,集合式多曲线微调也始终超过特定组别的业绩。 虽然扩展至更分明的容器仍未确定,但这些观测结果支持进一步探索经过广泛调整的模型,这些模型是经过不同临床病例培训的,而不是完全依靠每个临床分组的单独模型。

blocks.en: Beyond voxel-wise reconstruction metrics, super-resolution improved vessel depiction on derived PCMRA, with reduced background signal and clearer delineation of major arterial branches – improvements of possible relevance to downstream image analysis tasks including segmentation, centerline extraction, and standardized placement of analysis planes. In the moyamoya case, smaller vessels surrounding the affected proximal M1 region appeared more conspicuous after super-resolution and were incompletely captured by the TOF-derived arterial labels. This enabled exploratory visualization and quantification using super-resolved PCMRA masks. However, these vessels are small, tortuous, and close to or below the effective spatial resolution of the acquired data, and the high-resolution reference remains uncertain in this territory. Disease-specific conclusions therefore require validation in larger moyamoya cohorts and against independent angiographic or physiologic references.
blocks.zh: 除了 voxel 的重建度量表外,超分辨率改进了对衍生的PCMRA 的描述,减少了背景信号,对主要动脉分支的更清晰的划分 — — 可能与下游图像分析任务相关的改进,包括分解,中线取出以及分析平面的标准化布置. 在moyamoya案中,在超解后,围绕受影响的近缘M1区域的较小船只显得更明显,被TOF衍生的动脉标签所捕获。 这使得可以使用超解的PCMRA口罩进行探索可视化和量化. 然而,这些船只规模小,曲折,接近或低于已获得数据的有效空间分辨率,高分辨率的参考在此地仍然不确定. 因此,针对具体疾病的结论需要在较大的moyamoya群体中加以验证,并对照独立的血管或生理学参考。

blocks.en: Compared with previous cerebrovascular super-resolution studies, which have often relied on synthetic or indirect reference settings or limited in vivo validation, the present study directly evaluated synthetic-pretrained and transfer-learned models against acquired high-resolution data across heterogeneous cohorts Rutkowski et al. (2021) ; Shit et al. (2022) ; Ferdian et al. (2023) . By combining voxel-wise reconstruction metrics with complementary angiographic and hemodynamic evaluation, the findings provide early evidence for the translational potential of intracranial super-resolution 4D Flow MRI. Although the approximately 9-minute standard-resolution protocol substantially reduced scan time relative to the high-resolution reference, it remains lengthy for routine clinical use. These findings should therefore be viewed as an intermediate step toward clinically feasible intracranial 4D Flow MRI, alongside continued work on acquisition acceleration, motion correction, reproducibility, and disease-specific hemodynamic validation Mahinrad et al. (2022) ; Fico et al. (2023) ; Aristova et al. (2022) ; Cao et al. (2024) ; Wen et al. (2019) ; Rivera-Rivera et al. (2022) ; Wåhlin et al. (2022) ; Xia et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 与以往的脑血管超分辨率研究(这些研究往往依赖合成或间接的参考环境或在活体验证方面受到限制)相比,本研究直接对照Rutkowski等人(2021);Shit等人(2022);Ferdian等人(2023)。 通过将 voxel-with 重建度量表与互补血管学和血动力学评价相结合,这些结果为颅内超分辨率4D流磁共振的翻译潜力提供了早期证据. 尽管与高分辨参考相比,大约9分钟的标准分辨率协议大大缩短了扫描时间,但对于常规的临床使用来说仍然很长. 因此,这些调查结果应被视为临床上可行的4D型内流磁共振反应的中间步骤,同时继续开展以下工作:加速获取、运动矫正、再生和针对特定疾病的出血力学验证Mahinrad等人(2022年);Fico等人(2023年);Aristova等人(2022年);Cao等人(2024年);Wen等人(2019年);Rivera-Rivera等人(2022年);Wåhlin等人(2022年);Xia等人(2025年)。

blocks.en: This study has a few notable limitations. First, cohort sizes were modest, particularly for the disease cohorts, and only one participant per cohort was held out for final testing. The analyses were therefore descriptive and cannot establish participant-level statistical significance or disease-specific effects. The cohorts were also not demographically matched and differed in scanner platform and acquisition characteristics, which may confound direct cross-cohort comparisons, although this heterogeneity also provided a pragmatic test of domain shift. Second, voxel-wise fine-tuning and evaluation relied on HR-derived LR inputs, ensuring exact spatiotemporal correspondence; these inputs may not reproduce all artifacts present in independently acquired standard-resolution scans. Native standard-resolution acquisitions were therefore retained for angiographic and hemodynamic analyses. Third, the high-resolution scans were themselves noisy, particularly near vessel boundaries, and TOF-derived reference masks were subject to registration and thresholding uncertainty. Finally, no independent external test dataset or independent physiologic reference, such as flow-phantom or invasive flow measurements, was available. External multi-center validation and independent reference measurements will therefore be required before clinical performance can be established.
blocks.zh: 这项研究有一些显著的局限性。 首先,组群规模不大,特别是针对疾病组群,每个组群只有一个参与者被扣作最后测试。 因此,这些分析是描述性的,不能确定参与者一级的统计意义或具体疾病的影响。 这些组别在人口结构上也不相称,在扫描仪平台和获取特征上也不尽相同,这可能会混淆直接的交叉比较,尽管这种异同性也为域位转移提供了实用的测试. 第二,对从Voxel到LR的微调和评价依赖于HR衍生的LR输入,确保准确的spatiotempic函证;这些输入可能不会复制独立获得的标准分辨率扫描中的所有文物。 因此,原生标准分辨率的获取被保留用于血管学和血动力学分析。 第三,高分辨率扫描本身很吵,特别是在船只边界附近,TOF衍生的参考口罩要进行登记和确定界限。 最后,没有独立的外部测试数据集或独立的物理参考,如流-幻或入侵流测量。 因此,在确定临床表现之前,需要外部多中心验证和独立参考测量。

blocks.en: In conclusion, synthetic-pretrained deep learning-based super-resolution generalized to heterogeneous in vivo 4D Flow MRI data, with transfer learning providing additional gains and pooled multi-cohort fine-tuning showing the most consistent overall performance. Super-resolution also improved vessel depiction and supported exploratory hemodynamic assessment in small cerebrovascular territories. These findings support further multi-center validation of broadly adapted super-resolution models for intracranial 4D Flow MRI.
blocks.zh: 最后,合成预科深层的基于学习的超分辨率在活性4D流磁共振数据中被泛指为异质,转移学习提供了额外的收益并集合了多曲线微调,显示出最一致的整体性能. 超分辨率还改进了船只的描绘,并支持了小脑血管地段的探险出血力学评估. 这些结论支持进一步多中心验证广泛适应的4D流内核磁共振超分辨率模型.

blocks.en: This section provides implementation details for (i) four-dimensional flow magnetic resonance imaging (4D Flow MRI) preprocessing, (ii) voxel-wise artery labeling, (iii) centerline-based analysis plane placement, and (iv) direction-consistency mask refinement used prior to voxel-wise and hemodynamic analyses.

blocks.en: Four-dimensional flow magnetic resonance imaging (4D Flow MRI) preprocessing followed the correction and vessel-analysis workflow described in previous work Vali et al. (2019) ; Aristova et al. (2019) ; Winter et al. (2024) , including eddy-current correction, co-registration of time-of-flight (TOF) angiography, TOF segmentation threshold refinement, centerline extraction from the TOF-derived vessel masks, and subsequent vessel analysis. Extracranial datasets were processed by an investigator with more than 10 years of experience in neurovascular 4D Flow MRI. Intracranial datasets were processed by a doctoral researcher who had been trained in the workflow by the experienced investigator and subsequently performed processing independently according to the same protocol.
blocks.zh: 四维流磁共振成像(4D Flow MRI)预处理遵循了前作"Vali等"(2019年);"Aristova等"(2019年);"Winter等"(2024年)所描述的校正和船体分析工作流程,包括: eddy-c流校正,飞行时间(TOF)血管学共同登记,TOF分解阈值改进,从TOF衍生出的船只口罩中取出中线,以及后续的船体分析. 外源数据集由一位在神经血管4D流磁共振方面有10多年经验的调查员处理. 内部数据集由一位博士研究员进行处理,他接受了经验丰富的调查员对工作流程的培训,随后按照同一协议独立进行处理。

blocks.en: TOF angiography served as a common anatomical reference across LR, HR, and super-resolved reconstructions. Although TOF-based segmentation may be affected by signal dropout and registration error, use of the same TOF-derived segmentation reduced the potential for reconstruction-dependent segmentation differences to bias comparisons.
blocks.zh: TOF Angiography是整个LR,HR和超解析重建的共同解剖参考. 虽然基于TOF的分解可能受信号中断和注册错误的影响,但使用相同的TOF衍生分解会将依赖重建的分解差异降低为偏差比较的可能性.

blocks.en: For intracranial datasets, a U-Net-based model Bisbal et al. (2026) generated initial voxel-wise artery labels for the Circle of Willis, which were visually reviewed and corrected when needed by the doctoral researcher using ITK-SNAP Yushkevich et al. (2006) . Extracranial vessel territories were delineated manually. The following artery labels were used for reporting: internal carotid arteries (ICAs), middle cerebral arteries (MCAs), anterior cerebral arteries (ACAs), posterior cerebral arteries (PCAs), basilar artery (BA), and posterior communicating arteries (PCOMs) when clearly identifiable. For the extracranial cohort, labels comprised the ICAs and vertebral arteries (VAs), manually labeled by the doctoral researcher. No formal inter- or intrarater variability analysis was performed.
blocks.zh: 就颅内数据集而言,一个基于U-Net的模型Bisbal等人(2026年)为Willis圈产生了初步的阴道动脉标签,在博士研究员使用ITK-SNAP Yushkevich等人(2006年)进行视像审查和纠正。 外出船只领土是人工划定的。 以下动脉标注用于报告:内颈动脉(ICA),中脑动脉(MCA),外脑动脉(ACA),后脑动脉(PCA),巴氏动脉(BA),后相交流动脉(PCOM)在明确可识别时. 对于体外组群,标签由ICA和脊椎动脉组成,由博士研究员手工标出. 没有进行正式的州际或州内变化分析。

blocks.en: For plane-based hemodynamic quantification, analysis planes were placed along each labeled vessel segment using the corresponding TOF-derived centerlines. Planes were generated perpendicular to the local centerline tangent and placed at equidistant spacing of 0.5 mm along the centerline. For the moyamoya-associated vessels (MMV-1–MMV-4), a spacing of 0.25 mm was used to account for their smaller size. Each plane group and artery reported was visually quality-controlled to exclude planes at intersecting bifurcations, and to ensure consistent lumen coverage across reconstructions.
blocks.zh: 对于以平面为主的血动力量化,使用相应的TOF衍生中线,将分析平面沿每个有标签的船段放置. 平面与局部中线正切相垂直,沿中线相距为0.5毫米。 对于与moyamoya相联的船只(MMV-1-MMV-4),其相距为0.25毫米,以表示其较小的尺寸。 所报告的每架飞机组和动脉都受到视质控制,以排除相交接处的飞机,并确保整个重建期间的光圈覆盖。

blocks.en: To improve robustness to isolated spurious velocity voxels - particularly prevalent near the vessel boundary - a direction-consistency refinement step was applied within the TOF-derived lumen mask prior to voxel-wise comparisons and hemodynamic analyses. Specifically, voxels were removed if their velocity direction deviated by more than an angular threshold θ \theta from the mean direction of neighboring velocity vectors within a 5-voxel radius, with θ \theta chosen in the range 60-90 ∘ depending on the dataset. A qualitative example of the refinement effect is shown in Figure S1 , illustrating suppression of isolated locally incoherent voxels.

blocks.en: Synthetic pretraining data were generated from four patient-specific cerebrovascular computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations previously used in related intracranial super-resolution studies Ferdian et al. (2023) ; Welin Odeback et al. (2026) . The simulations comprised time-resolved 3D velocity fields derived from patient-specific cerebrovascular geometries under physiologic boundary conditions and included anatomies with varying degrees of steno-occlusive disease. Each simulated velocity field was paired with a co-registered magnitude volume derived from clinical magnitude data and mapped to the CFD anatomy. Paired synthetic high- and low-resolution 4D Flow MRI were then generated using an acquisition-mimicking pipeline incorporating k-space truncation, noise injection matched to clinically observed levels, and dual-velocity-encoding reconstruction. This provided inherently co-registered high- and low-resolution pairs for supervised pretraining before in vivo fine-tuning. Further details are provided in Welin Odeback et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 合成前训练数据出自之前用于相关颅内超解研究的四种患者特异性脑血管计算流体动力学(CFD)模拟数据Ferdian等 (2023); Welin Odeback等 (2026). 模拟包括从生理边界条件下的患者特有脑血管地美图中得出的时间解脱出3D速度场,并包括不同程度的血清闭塞性疾病的解剖. 每个模拟速度场被配对成一个共同注册的星等量从临床星等数据得到,并被映射到CFD解剖学上. 然后,利用包括k-空间截流、与临床观测水平相匹配的噪声注入和双高速编码重建的购置-仿真管道,生成了Paired合成高分辨率和低分辨率4D流磁共振。 这提供了内在共同登记的高分辨和低分辨的对子,在进行体外微调前进行有监督的预训。 详情见Welin Odeback等人(2026年)。

blocks.en: We implemented a 3D residual convolutional neural network (CNN) based on the 4DFlowNet-inspired Ferdian et al. (2023) generator design in Welin Odeback et al. (2026) , using residual-in-residual dense blocks (RRDBs) Wang et al. (2018) as the main feature extractor. The network takes as input a low-resolution velocity patch 𝐯 = [ u , v , w ] \mathbf{v}=[u,v,w] and magnitude information, which are first encoded by two 3D convolution layers per branch. Velocity and magnitude features are concatenated and fused by an additional 3D convolution to form a shared low-resolution feature representation. This representation is then processed by a stack of four RRDBs in the low-resolution space. Spatial upsampling to the target grid is performed using trilinear interpolation. In the high-resolution space, features are refined by an additional stack of two RRDBs. Finally, the network branches into three output heads with two 3D convolutions each to predict the super-resolved velocity components u ^ \hat{u} , v ^ \hat{v} , and w ^ \hat{w} , which are concatenated to form the final 3-channel output. All convolution layers use symmetric padding.

The in silico training objective was defined as L in ​ - ​ silico = MSE Non ​ - ​ Fluid + MSE Boundary + MSE Core + μ ​ ∑ θ 2 , L_{\mathrm{in\text{-}silico}}=\mathrm{MSE}_{\mathrm{Non\text{-}Fluid}}+\mathrm{MSE}_{\mathrm{Boundary}}+\mathrm{MSE}_{\mathrm{Core}}+\mu\sum\theta^{2}, (S1) where the mean-squared error (MSE) was computed over three disjoint regions Ω ∈ { Non ​ - ​ Fluid , Boundary , Core } \Omega\in\{\mathrm{Non\text{-}Fluid},\mathrm{Boundary},\mathrm{Core}\} .
Here, Boundary \mathrm{Boundary} and Core \mathrm{Core} denote near-wall and core-flow voxels, respectively, obtained by morphological erosion of the binary vessel mask. For a given region Ω \Omega , the MSE was computed as MSE Ω = 1 N Ω ​ ∑ i ∈ Ω ‖ 𝐱 SR i − 𝐱 HR i ‖ 2 2 , \mathrm{MSE}_{\Omega}=\frac{1}{N_{\Omega}}\sum_{i\in\Omega}\left\lVert\mathbf{x}^{i}_{\mathrm{SR}}-\mathbf{x}^{i}_{\mathrm{HR}}\right\rVert_{2}^{2}, (S2) where 𝐱 SR i \mathbf{x}^{i}_{\mathrm{SR}} and 𝐱 HR i \mathbf{x}^{i}_{\mathrm{HR}} denote the predicted super-resolved and reference high-resolution velocity vectors at voxel i i , and N Ω N_{\Omega} is the number of voxels in region Ω \Omega . The final term, μ ​ ∑ θ 2 \mu\sum\theta^{2} , denotes an ℓ 2 \ell_{2} weight decay with coefficient empirically set to μ = 5 ⋅ 10 − 7 \mu=5\cdot 10^{-7} .

For in vivo fine-tuning, spatially matched standard- (LR) and high-resolution (HR) patch sets were generated from the HR acquisitions, with LR inputs obtained by k-space cropping. Paired LR and HR patches were then extracted using the same patch-based sampling strategy as in the synthetic setting. Because in vivo HR data are affected by noise and may contain isolated spurious voxels, particularly near vessel boundaries, the fine-tuning objective was simplified to separate only non-fluid and fluid regions: L in ​ - ​ vivo = MSE Non ​ - ​ Fluid + MSE Fluid + μ ​ ∑ θ 2 . L_{\mathrm{in\text{-}vivo}}=\mathrm{MSE}_{\mathrm{Non\text{-}Fluid}}+\mathrm{MSE}_{\mathrm{Fluid}}+\mu\sum\theta^{2}. (S3) The non-fluid region was defined as voxels outside the full co-registered TOF-derived vessel mask. Additionally, to further reduce the influence of noisy high-resolution target voxels within the vessel, the fluid region was defined using a refined vessel mask based on the aforementioned voxel removal strategy (Section S1 ) for each case, designed to exclude spurious voxels while delineating the lumen. This formulation avoids training on unreliable HR target voxels, while preserving the denoising behavior learned during synthetic pretraining.

blocks.en: All models were implemented in TensorFlow (v2.10) using Python and trained on an NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPU (40 GB). The framework comprised one synthetic-pretrained baseline model and five transfer-learned variants.For synthetic pretraining, the network was initialized using a Glorot uniform initializer and trained for 100 epochs using the Adam optimizer with batch size 20 and an initial learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , decayed by a factor of 2 after 50 epochs. Transfer-learned models were initialized from the synthetic-pretrained weights and fine-tuned using Adam with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} while freezing the initial low-resolution feature-extraction blocks (four RRDBs). Freezing the early layers was intended to reduce the number of trainable parameters and limit over-adaptation to the small target dataset and was selected based on preliminary model-development experiments. Because a formal ablation of freezing strategies was outside the scope of this study, this approach should be considered a fixed fine-tuning design choice rather than a systematically optimized strategy. Final model checkpoints were selected based on validation set performance. Total training time was approximately 19 hours for synthetic pretraining and approximately 1 hour for fine-tuning each model.

blocks.en: The baseline model was pretrained on the full set of n = 4 n=4 synthetic computational fluid dynamics (CFD)-derived velocity fields used in previous works Ferdian et al. (2023) ; Welin Odeback et al. (2026) . In total, the synthetic training set comprised 123,500 aligned HR/LR patch pairs, generated by sampling 10 patches per CFD time frame and applying rigid rotation augmentation to each patch.

blocks.en: For in vivo transfer learning, cohort-specific and pooled fine-tuning used the participant-level partitions summarized in Table S1 . One participant per cohort was held out for final testing. For the healthy intracranial and extracranial cohorts, four participants were used for training and one separate participant for validation. For the neurovascular and neuroinflammatory cohorts, two participants were used for training, with model-optimization patches resampled from one training participant because no additional participant was available. Final test partitions were participant-disjoint in all cohorts and were not used during training or model selection.
blocks.zh: 在虚拟转移学习中,针对组群和集合的微调使用了表S1概述的参与者级别分区。 每组有一名参加者被安排进行最后测试。 对于健康腹腔和外腔组群,有4名参与者用于培训,另有1名参与者用于验证。 对于神经血管和神经炎群而言,有两名参与者用于培训,一名培训参与者为模型优化补丁作再印,因为没有其他参与者。 最终测试分区在所有组群中都是参与者-离队的,在培训或模型选择过程中没有使用。

blocks.en: The held-out test subjects were: intracranial healthy (male, 28 years), extracranial healthy (female, 23 years), neuroinflammatory (male, 39 years, multiple sclerosis), and neurovascular (female, 31 years, with left-sided moyamoya vasculopathy involving the proximal M1 segment).

blocks.en: To emphasize the impact of data diversity rather than the number of samples, we adjusted the sampling rate across cohorts to account for differences in the number of subjects and cardiac frames. Specifically, cohort-specific fine-tuning used 40 patches per time frame for the intracranial and extracranial cohort models and 80 patches per time frame for the two patient cohort models, which after augmentation corresponded to 10,000 (intracranial), 15,200 (extracranial), and 8,000 patches each (neurovascular and neuroinflammatory). The multi-cohort model sampled 10 patches per time frame from intracranial and extracranial cohorts and 20 patches per time frame from each patient cohort, yielding 10,300 augmented patches in total. For validation, 50 random patches per time frame were sampled from the validation subjects across cohorts.

blocks.en: As an external benchmark, we evaluated the cerebrovascular 4DFlowNet Ferdian et al. (2023) using the publicly available pretrained model weights from the authors’ repository ( https://github.com/EdwardFerdian/4DFlowNet ). The model was not retrained on the present synthetic or in vivo datasets. For voxel-wise comparison, 4DFlowNet was applied to the same HR-derived LR inputs used for evaluation of the present models, and outputs were evaluated against the same HR references using the same TOF-derived vessel masks.
blocks.zh: 作为外部基准,我们利用作者资料库(https://github.com/EdwardFerdian/4DFlowNet)提供的公开预选模型权重,评价了脑血管4DFlowNet Ferdian等人(2023年)。 该模型没有在目前的合成数据或活体数据集上重新训练。 为进行Voxel类比较,4DFlowNet被应用于用于评价目前模型的相同的HR-衍生LR输入,并且使用相同的TOF衍生船只口罩对照相同的HR参考数据评价了产出。

blocks.en: While complete network architecture and training details are provided in Ferdian et al. (2023) , the main differences relative to the present baseline model are summarized here. First, while the same set of n = 4 n=4 cerebrovascular flow simulations was utilized, the publicly available cerebrovascular 4DFlowNet weights were trained using the data split and preprocessing strategy described in Ferdian et al. (2023) . Here, two CFD-derived cases were used for training, one for validation, and one for testing. In contrast, the present baseline model was pretrained using all four available CFD-derived cerebrovascular cases, with subsequent evaluation performed only on the held-out in vivo test subjects described in the main manuscript. Second, the synthetic image-generation pipelines differed. In 4DFlowNet, low-resolution inputs were generated using the original cerebrovascular 4DFlowNet downsampling procedure, designed to mimic spatial-resolution degradation and noise in 4D Flow MRI. In the present work, synthetic pretraining used a related but updated simulation-to-MRI pipeline described in Welin Odeback et al. (2026) , which extends this framework by incorporating a more acquisition-mimicking reconstruction procedure, including dual-velocity-encoding reconstruction.
blocks.zh: Ferdian等人(2023年)提供了完整的网络架构和培训细节,但在此概述了与目前基线模型的主要差异。 首先,虽然采用了同一套n=4n=4的脑血管流模拟,但使用Ferdian等人(2023年)所描述的数据分解和预处理策略对公开使用的脑血管4DFlowNet重量进行了培训。 这里,有两个CFD衍生的病例用于培训,一个用于验证,一个用于测试. 相比之下,目前的基线模型是利用所有四种可用的CFD衍生脑血管病例进行预先培训的,随后仅对主要手稿所描述的活体试验课题进行了评估。 第二,合成图像生成管道不同。 在4DFlowNet中,使用最初的脑血管4DFlowNet下取样程序生成了低分辨率输入,该程序旨在模仿4D流磁共振中的空间分辨率降解和噪音. 在本作中,合成预训使用由Welin Odeback等(2026年)所描述的相干但更新的模拟至MRI管线,该管线通过纳入更能模仿收购的重建程序来扩展这一框架,包括双高速编码重建.

blocks.en: These differences were not modified or harmonized, because the purpose of the benchmark was to compare the present synthetic-pretrained and transfer-learned models against an established, previously published cerebrovascular super-resolution framework. Consequently, differences in performance between 4DFlowNet and the present models may reflect not only network architecture, but also differences in training-data usage and synthetic data generation.
blocks.zh: 这些差异没有修改或统一,因为基准的目的是将目前的合成预培训和转移学习模型同以前公布的大脑血管超分辨率框架进行比较。 因此,4DFlowNet与目前模型之间的性能差异不仅可能反映网络架构,也可能反映培训数据使用和合成数据生成方面的差异。

blocks.en: This comparison represents benchmarking against an externally developed model, not validation on an independent external dataset.
blocks.zh: 这种比较是参照外部开发的模式,而不是对独立的外部数据集进行验证的基准。
